# Olai

> Swedish data and growth consultancy combining performance media, data engineering, measurement infrastructure, and the proprietary Quiver intelligence platform.

## What We Do

- **Performance Marketing** — Strategy, execution, and optimization across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat. Full-funnel, channel-native.
- **Data & Analytics** — Server-side tracking, attribution modeling, BigQuery pipelines, GA4, dashboards. Profit-aware by design.
- **Quiver (Proprietary Platform)** — Cross-channel ad data unification, automated reporting, real-time monitoring, custom alerting (Slack/email), profit-based bidding signals, warehouse-native (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).
- **Consulting & Strategy** — Audits, roadmaps, team enablement. Embed model; no handoffs, no lock-in.

## Quiver Platform Features

- Cross-channel analytics: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap — normalized data
- Automated reporting (self-writing reports)
- Real-time performance monitoring
- Custom alerting — user-defined thresholds via Slack or email
- Profit-based signals — margin-aware bidding, not just revenue
- Warehouse-native — plugs into BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift
- Demo metrics (Acme Co.): Total spend €109.0k, Revenue €372.4k, Profit margin 31.4%, ROAS 3.42×

3. **Platform-agnostic** — Goes where the data is, no kickback-driven recommendations
4. **Swedish craft, Nordic reach** — Swedish-built, deployed across Nordics
